review_comments.body: I'm not sure ignoring format type is a right thing to do - for example, in the current implementation invalid format specifier for this data type (e.g. `"{:0.3f}".format(statscol)`) doesn't cause an exception - specifier just has no effect, pformat is always used.
hm right, but I wouldn't know what to do with a format specifier for a statscollector. Any suggestions?

I think the way to go is to check the format, use pformat if a string is requested, use repr if repr is requested, raise for numeric formats. But it looks like a lot of code without a clear purpose; maybe using `__str__` hook instead of `__format__` is easier.
